newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE-100 to find upside barrier of 4,350.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE-100 to find upside barrier of 4,350.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 index will continue to move in a narrow trading range with upside resistance at the 4,350 to 4,375 level, chart analysts said on Tuesday.

In the past three weeks, the index has moved between an intraday low of 4,200.5 on April 1 and an intraday high of 4,335.1 on April 11 and analysts see the FTSE index developing a sideways trend for the next month. By 0839 GMT the FTSE 100 index was up 1.5 points at 4,330.1.
Richard Marshall at Investment Research of Cambridge said the index was underpinned at the 4,314 level but saw upside resistance at 4,350.
